latestVersion.changelog:
Best Highlight Editor — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: AI-powered highlight reel editor for rapid video auto-cut and export.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB) and export of 1080p MP4 highlight reels.
- Automatic cloud-based highlight detection, session/token management, and easy download.
- User-friendly workflows: quick edit, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Integrated with cloud GPU backend with credit and error handling.
- Requires brief setup; no manual slider or local installation needed.
